Ciro Castro as a licensee and transfer his 50% ownership interest to current licensee Mr. 
Franciso Perez, increasing his interest to 100%. 
 
4. t/a The Jerk Pit, located at 9078 Baltimore Avenue, College Park, 20740. See letter 
dated April 3, 2025, regarding a request for an extension to renew their license. The 
establishment holds a Class B, Beer, Wine and Liquor license. 
 
5. t/a Kitchen Near You, located at 5321 Ager Road, Hyattsvilile, 20782. See letter dated 
April 7, 2025, regarding a request to approve an additional ninety (90) days to 
effectuate the license.  (1st Request) 
 
6. t/a Maryland Club @ XFINITY Center, located at 8500 Paint Branch Drive, College 
Park, 20740. See letter dated April 8, 2025, regarding notification of the security 
interest agreement. 
 
7. t/a Amigo’s Mexican Grill, located at 13600 Baltimore Avenue, Suite 400, Laurel, 
20707. See letter dated April 10, 2025, regarding a request to use an outdoor tent from 
May 2, 2025 through May, 5, 2025.  
 
8. t/a Salsa Brava, located at 14933 Baltimore Avenue, Laurel, 20207. See letter dated 
April 10, 2025, regarding a request to add a tent for their Cinco de Mayo events at the 
restaurant from May 2, 2025 through May 5, 2025. 
 
9. t/a Maxey Liquors, located at 7513 Allentown Road, Fort Washington, 20744. See 
letter dated April 14, 2025, regarding a request to approve an additional one-hundred 
eighty (180) days to effectuate the license. The establishment is experiencing delays 
with obtaining the required documents and permits. (1st Request) 
 
10. t/a D 3 Social, located at 7215 Baltimore Avenue, College Park, 20740. See letter dated 
April 14, 2025, regarding to approve an additional one-hundred eighty (180) days to 
effectuate the license. The establishment is experiencing delays with obtaining the 
required documents and permits. (3rd Request)  
 
11. t/a The Carolina Kitchen Sea & Soul, located at 10250 Martin Luther King Jr. 
Highway, Unit 16208-16214, Bowie, 20720. See letter dated April 14, 2025, regarding

license. The establishment is experiencing delays with obtaining the require documents 
and permits. (4th Request) 
 
12. t/a Carolina Kitchen A Taste of Louisiana, located at 16208 Market Place, Unit 
16208-16214, Bowie, 20716. See letter dated April 14, 2025, regarding a request to 
approve an additional time one-hundered eighty (180) days to effectuate the license. 
The establishment is experiencing delays with obtaining the require documents and 
permits. (4th Request)
